enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket over body. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Adjust air conditioner. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stretch arms. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Take bread from breadbox. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Take toast out. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Pack bag with laptop. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read news on phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Put on scrubs. Turn on computer. Check emails. Review patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Measure blood pressure. Check temperature. Administer medication. Update patient records. Consult with doctor. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Respond to pages. Clean equipment. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk into kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Watch video. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Scroll social media. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Pick up book. Read book.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Walk into bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Turn off lamp. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
